_about: Models for the furniture NoorFengShui places, by kind (D87). Any model Godot loads: a Synty prefab, a .glb or .tscn of our own. A kind with no entry, or whose model isn't on disk (Synty is licensed and not in this repository), keeps BadBuilding's generated shape. fit: stretch (to the footprint and the piece's height), footprint (to the footprint, own height), uniform (own proportions, inside the footprint). yaw: degrees, turns the model so its front faces +Z. Kinds: bed_double bed_single nightstand wardrobe desk bookshelf sofa armchair tv_unit coffee_table dining_table counter fridge kitchen_table bath shower toilet basin washer shoe_cabinet coat_rack shelves.
